entries.38bde7bc934f1f67: The breakdown of consolidated net sales of ¥68,268 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is: by segment, net sales to external customers of ¥47,861 million for the Coatings-related business and ¥20,407 million for the Electronics-related business. Net sales by region were ¥58,183 million for Japan, ¥8,898 million for Asia, ¥1,088 million for North and Central America and ¥97 million for other regions, with Japan accounting for the majority. No single customer accounts for 10% or more of consolidated net sales. In its analysis of operating results, the company cites a decrease in domestic automobile production volume by automobile manufacturers, its main customers, as a cause of the decline in Coatings-related business sales.

entries.ae65668353ba9245: The company, together with 15 consolidated subsidiaries, 1 unconsolidated subsidiary and 4 equity-method affiliates (21 companies in total), operates two businesses: the Coating-Related Business and the Electronics-Related Business (as of March 31, 2026).
entries.aed3e9851c0254a5: Painting line-related construction, interior and exterior renovation-related construction, and painting contracting
entries.b5c31890276591db: Building on the film-forming technology it has cultivated in the automotive industry, the company explains that its Technical Center at the Kanagawa Office carries out total planning of paints together with painting equipment, devices and apparatus, and develops new materials and new construction methods. The company states that through its group it provides painting contracting and paint color-matching processing, and offers products and services that contribute to solving customers' challenges, from paint selection and painting specifications to painting methods and painting environment. For Hall ICs, the company explains that as a dedicated sales agency it handles quality, technology, global logistics and visual inspection, and has built a system that holds inventory at multiple domestic and overseas sites to ensure stable supply.
entries.c1a16bfc102a8dcc: This is a business model in which the company purchases paints, chemical products and electronic components from suppliers such as paint manufacturers, sells them to manufacturing customers led by automakers, and also handles painting line construction and painting contracting work.
entries.ca40b8727197d850: Centered on sales of Hall ICs, which are magnetic sensors, it also sells in-vehicle software and LED lighting products. As a specialized distributor of Hall ICs, it holds inventory at multiple locations in Japan and overseas and has built a structure enabling stable supply. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥20,407 million.
entries.caa57c371770feb1: The company has set a medium-term management plan, 'MAP24-26' (fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026), and its target image for 10 years from now is 'Establishing the global brand O-Well'. Under its medium-term management policy 'Innovating and creating the value offered', it states that it will strengthen the value it offers, shifting from a 'product supply' model to a 'one-stop solution provision' model. In the Coatings-related business, under its key policy 'Creating the future of coatings', it states that it will expand functions centered on film-forming capability, and in the Electronics-related business, under its key policy 'Expanding the value offered', it states that it will work on adding and expanding the functions it delivers. The plan's numerical targets concern future matters, so they are not reproduced here.
